WILLIAM B. NYE DIRECTOR
DEPARTMENT OF NATURAL RESOURCES
OHIO DEPARTMENTS BUILDING COLUMBUS 43215
28.3
August 17, 1972
United States Department of Interior Bureau of Outdoor Recreation Washington, D.C. 20240 Attn: James Watt, Director
RE: Off-Road Vehicles on Public
Lands in Ohio-Kl4
Dear Director Watt:
The Ohio Legislature recently passed House Bill No. 214 (of which a copy is enclosed) providing for the development of off-road vehicle trails in Ohio. As Director of the Ohio Department of Natural Resources, I and my staff have been given prime responsibility for designating and developing ORV sites in Ohio.
In light of this responsibility and your recent draft Environmental Impact Statement for the Implementation of Executive Order 11644-Use of Off-Road Vehicles on Public Lands-K14, I request that our state agency be consulted before any federally owned public lands in Ohio are designated for ORV use. Through proper coordination of our efforts, we can assure environmentally sound management of state and federal lands for recreation vehicles.
Sincerely,
WILLIAM B. NYE Director
